definitions.explanation: An abbreviation for Saturday (土曜日) and Sunday (日曜日), used to refer to the weekend.

examples.japanese: {土日|どにち}は{休|やす}みです。
examples.english: Saturday and Sunday are days off.

examples.japanese: {土日|どにち}はいつも{混|こ}んでいるので{平日|へいじつ}に{行|い}こう。
examples.english: It's always crowded on weekends, so let's go on a weekday.

examples.japanese: この{店|みせ}は{土日|どにち}{祝日|しゅくじつ}も{営業|えいぎょう}しているので、{仕事|しごと}の{後|あと}でなくても{利用|りよう}できる。
examples.english: This shop is open on weekends and holidays too, so you can visit even if it's not after work.

notes:
USAGE:
A very common abbreviation in everyday Japanese. Often seen on signs, schedules, and in conversation. Frequently combined with {祝日|しゅくじつ} (national holidays) as {土日祝|どにちしゅく} or {土日|どにち}{祝日|しゅくじつ}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {土日|どにち}{休|やす}み: weekends off
- {土日|どにち}{祝日|しゅくじつ}: weekends and holidays
- {土日|どにち}も{営業|えいぎょう}: open on weekends too
- {土日|どにち}に{働|はたら}く: to work on weekends

SIMILAR WORDS:
{土日|どにち} specifically means Saturday and Sunday. {週末|しゅうまつ} (weekend) is slightly more general and can sometimes include Friday evening. {休日|きゅうじつ} (day off, holiday) refers to any non-working day.
